timing_boundary: Timed all command only; preparation, strict QC and independent decode checks excluded. Cold=new project cache/out, warm=next all with same project/config. OS cache not flushed. A/B order alternates per pair.
shipping_code: d9de516: rejection accounting cannot advance signed proof; original bounded full PNG validation and receipt fixes retained, upstream main merged, deeper prefetch prototypes removed
native_validation_gap: Old four-block supplemental check failed on frame462 with only four signed fences. A diagnostic-only unchanged-control-flow reproduction established five actual negative-callback proof advances without their post-paint fences (first phase requests779/822/56, second phase9/456). This is not a counter undercount. The physical cause of differing borrowed-buffer observations is unknown. Old experiment reporter success and cumulative counter checks do NOT establish every signed phase was fenced; pre-fix results remain historical exploration, not final delivery qualification.
native_fix: FeedNonAdvancingPaint cannot acquire advancement/output authority even if re-reading a rejected callback buffer becomes positive. Normal owned-copy/post-paint-fence flow remains unchanged. Deterministic callback mutation tests cover both signed phases, preserve all existing cases, and fail with the former callback substituted; clean/diagnostic modes and ordinary rejection attribution also covered.

native_validation.limit: Changed-positive real callback observations were rejected; the physical upstream cause is unknown. Structural restriction plus deterministic mutation tests prove the no-advance property, not aggregate fence counts alone.

limits: The larger gain against forced single-worker scheduling is not a gain against actual default scheduling.
All configuration gains use already-existing execution capabilities; the earlier PNG micro-optimization remains a separate, noise-level full-chain result.
One-pair screens are unqualified; the three-pair result is not a significance claim or cross-project/platform guarantee.
Increased concurrency costs memory/CPU. Summed tree RSS repeats shared mappings and sampling misses exact peaks; CPU is a lower bound.
Four-versus-three screening increased system swap use from 3602.12 to 5456.12 MiB across BOTH arms; no per-arm causal attribution.
No quality gate, proof, output quality, CI criterion, cache reuse policy or default setting was weakened.
No revival of NAVFREE, alternate BeginFrame capture, Electron, raw/shared-memory streaming or GPU redesign.
No portable-v2 SVG speed claim, no warm speed guarantee, no 50-percent goal claim.
This sanitized summary does not replace retained raw local evidence; absolute paths, licensed input assets and credentials are not published.
